column4: feature: Nice to have map has been implementedgit add -A the use of leaflet.js and an openstreetmap api rpute allowed me to display the location on a map for all members of the event. In doing this I needed to change the location input to be an autofill location. Note: Most of the js came form tutorials on leaflet.js website, as well as from ai, as I am completely unfamiliar with javascript.

feature: group leader can now close events and take attendance on who arrived or not. This attendance percentage is then shown next to the group members name in other events, as per client requirement. Note: the python db code was quite tricky, so an exensive use of githubs copilot was utilised

feature: as per client documentation, group leader - when assigning roles - can now choose to add a custom role. When a custom role is saved and created, it is added to a db table for that groups custom role, and can be selected again from the dropdown another time for convenience. Note: ai was used to generate some javascript and html, as IDK how to write that. end commit.
bug fix: I realised that there was no save button POSTing the role assignments, so now another person can see the updated roles in real time
